name: Byron Boldston
source:
Byron Boldston is one of Lone River's P&P Officers. After unfortunate circumstances caused him to leave the Army, he found work alongside his [url=https://vndb.org/c167448]former brother-in-arms[/url]. It's a more quite change in pace and lifestyle, but a considerably more safer and less dramatic one. Don't let his big stature confuse you. He's a big softy at heart.
